articleTitle: Simulation and Experiment of Safety Distance of Substation UAV Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Simulation and experiment of safety distance of substation UAV inspection. With the increasing maturity of UAV technology, the inspection of UAV in transmission lines has been widely carried out at present, but the inspection in substation is still in the initial stage, and the safe flight distance within the station has become the main factor restricting the application of UAV inspection. Therefore, four-rotor longitude and latitude M300RTK model was selected as the research object to build a 3D simulation platform of UAV and 220kV equipment, and to carry out the simulation test of UAV tolerance under electric field and electromagnetic environment of transformer equipment. The simulation results show that when the load current is less than 315A, the critical flight safety distance of UAV is 37cm; when the wire load current is more than 315A, the critical flight safety distance of UAV depends on the safety distance of magnetic field. The research results can provide theoretical reference for UAV substation inspection flight control and inspection path planning.

articleTitle: Research on human following technology of robot based on ECO-HC
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Due to the poor robustness of the following robot to stably follow the target and relocate the lost target in the dynamic environment, this paper proposes a mobile robot target following method combining YOLOv5 and ECO-HC tracking algorithm. It mainly uses the fast and accurate target detection ability of YOLOv5 to provide the necessary tracking target information for the ECO-HC tracking algorithm. By extracting the FHOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradient) feature and CN (Color Name) feature of the target to train the correlation filter, it is ensured that the following robot can follow the target for a long time. In order to avoid problems with the target loss caused by the block, using DIoU as a criterion for data matching, achieve target recognition. The target detection and tracking algorithm in ROS platform deployed to the mobile robot, and use the Kinectv2 depth camera to obtain follow real coordinates of target. The target following experiment is completed in the experimental scene, and the experimental results show that the mobile robot has strong robustness and can follow the target in real-time.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Mobile Robot Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To deal with these issues such as low initial population quality and slow convergence in the traditional algorithm, this article improves the genetic algorithm and applies it to the path planning for mobile robot. In order to improve the quality of the initial pathways, it generates paths via heuristic strategies; The fitness function is improved by a multi-objective function. The main operators of the algorithm are improved in this article, and the numerical values of crossover and mutation probabilities are adjusted by an adaptive adjustment method to better fit the problem. A catastrophe factor is also introduced to increase the diversity of algorithms and the ability to search globally. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Research and Development of Reuse Process and Equipment of MVR Evaporative Condensate-Membrane Filtration
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the aggravation of environmental pollution and water shortage, the discharge requirements of industrial wastewater are becoming more and more stringent, conventional wastewater treatment technology has been unable to meet the treatment requirements of high-difficulty wastewater, in order to satisfy the domestic high-difficultly wastewater treatment requirements, this paper adopts MVR technology to treat sewage, compared with the original technology, after the reverse osmosis system to add the detection and circulation pump device, the substandard wastewater can be treated again until it meets the discharge standards, greatly reduces the equipment investment and operating costs, improving the system efficiency. It can be seen that MVR evaporation technology has a broad application prospect in the direction of wastewater treatment.

articleTitle: Design of Microstrip Patch Filter Antenna Based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide High-Order Mode Feeding
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to achieve high integration and performance of the antenna at the same time, this paper proposes a dual layer filter antenna based on a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) cavity and a microstrip patch. The antenna first uses the ground coplanar waveguide (GCPW) structure at the bottom of the SIW to feed and excite the high-order TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">210</inf> mode of the SIW, then etches a rectangular slot at the intersection of two quasi TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">110</inf> modes to feed the microstrip patch and excite the TM10 mode of the patch. By simultaneously exciting two modes, a high gain filter antenna is formed. The simulation results show that within the passband of the antenna, the average gain is as high as 7dBi, which has a good filtering effect.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Microgrid Inverter Based on Parameter Adaptive VSG
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The inertia and damping of traditional virtual synchronous generator (VSG) are constant parameters, which leads to poor dynamic adjustment ability and poor power quality. A micro-grid inverter control strategy based on VSG’s moment of inertia and damping coefficient adaptive adjustment is adopted to dynamically adjust the moment of inertia and damping coefficient according to the power fluctuations of the system. First, the basic structure of VSG is constructed, the working principle of VSG and the influence of various parameters on the system dynamic adjustment performance are analyzed, and then combined with the output characteristics of synchronous generator, the inertia and damping parameters adaptive adjustment control strategy is used. In order to ensure the stable operation of the load, this paper simulates the influence of the load on the frequency and current when it is connected to the system. Finally, Matlab/Simulink simulation is used to compare the dynamic adjustment characteristics of power and frequency and the adjustment characteristics of adaptive parameters of VSG control under constant parameters and adaptive parameters, as well as the effective reduction of frequency fluctuation value of0.03Hz during load access.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of peak current mode controlled two-switch forward converter
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In this paper, an design example and circuit analysis of a two-switch forward converter are presented, which is aimed at meeting the auxiliary power supply requirements of marine power system. The main circuit parameters for the topology are calculated, and the small signal model of a two-switch forward converter used peak current control is analyzed. At the same time, the mathematical model of the feedback control loop composed of TL431 shunt regulator and optocoupler is given. On this basis, the compensation network is designed to improve the stability and robustness of the system. The results obtained from the experiment indicate that the output voltage of the developed converter is stable and its response speed is high when the load suddenly changes, which verifies the accuracy of the established model and the effectiveness of the compensation network design.

articleTitle: Lightweight DeepLabv3+ Segmentation Method for Substation Equipment Oil Leakage Image
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To efficiently and accurately detect and identify oil leakage in the substations oil-filled equipments, this paper proposes a lightweight segmentation model based on the improved DeepLabv3+ model. By using the lightweight segmentation model based on the improved DeepLabv3+ model. By using the lightweight MobilenetV2 network as the backbone feature extraction network, the model reduces the number of network parameters and improves the semantic segmentation efficiency. To improve the segmentation accuracy of small leaked oil region and the edges, a feature pyramid structure is introduced to enhance the feature extraction ability. In addition, a dataset of oil leakage images from substation oil-filled equipments is constructed for the oil leakage image segmentation, and experimental tests show that the proposed algorithm significantly improves segmentation performance. Compared with the DeepLabv3+ algorithm-based oil leakage detection model, the average intersection-over-union (IoU) is improved by 1.28%, and the number of model parameters decreased to 15.5% of the original. It meets the practical requirements of edge deployment model, and has high practicality.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Control System for Cold Energy Recovery on LNG Vessels
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The LNG ship cold energy recovery intelligent control system is designed by analysing the consumption and recycling of LNG ship cold energy and the various applications of LNG cold energy in ships. The design of the LNG ship cold energy recovery intelligent control system can solve the problems of excessive consumption of electrical energy and loss of cold energy from ships in China’s shipping industry. A series of optimisation evaluations on the architecture design of the LNG ship cold energy recovery intelligent control system and the design of the intelligent components of the system have revealed that the system has achieved excellent results in energy recovery, effectively filling the technical gap in energy recovery for LNG ships.

articleTitle: Dynamic path planning based on the fusion of improved RRT and DWA algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A hybrid algorithm combining improved RRT algorithm and dynamic window method is proposed to solve the path planning problem of robots in the environment of dynamic or unknown obstacles. Firstly, aiming at the problems of many redundant nodes and low efficiency in the RRT algorithm, the target bias sampling and parent node reselection strategies are used to improve them. Secondly, for the problems of poor environmental adaptability and difficulty in taking into account speed and safety in the dynamic window method, a DWA algorithm with fuzzy control of parameters is proposed, which dynamically adjusts the weight of the evaluation function according to the distance of the robot from the target and obstacle. Finally, the above improved RRT algorithm and fuzzy DWA algorithm are mixed to realize dynamic path programming. By comparing the simulation results, the effectiveness of the hybrid algorithm in the complex dynamic environment is verified.

articleTitle: State evaluation of intelligent microgrid based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to realize the goal of self-healing characteristics of smart microgrid, it is necessary to evaluate the real-time running status of smart microgrid accurately. Therefore, this paper will carry out the research on the real-time evaluation method of smart microgrid operation. Firstly, the correlation between intelligent microgrid and conventional power system is analyzed, appropriate evaluation indexes are selected, and the changes of each system during operation are analyzed by using entropy weight method, so as to obtain the weight of each index in the evaluation system. Secondly, according to the fuzzy evaluation method, an appropriate membership degree function is selected, and a new evaluation system is established around it to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the state of a single node of the smart microgrid. Finally, based on the node load level and node-path correlation degree, a new node weight evaluation method based on node load-path is proposed, which is combined with the single node state of the smart micro grid obtained above, and the real-time detection state of the whole smart micro grid is finally obtained, providing a new idea for the online monitoring and early warning of the smart micro grid. Finally, an intelligent microgrid in a region is taken as an example for simulation verification.

articleTitle: UAV Attitude Estimation Based on Improved Complementary Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that EKF and UKF algorithms based on Kalman filter algorithm framework require a large amount of computation and have high requirements on the processor chip, a UAV attitude estimation algorithm based on improved complementary filter algorithm is designed. The algorithm integrates the data of accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer with the gradient descent method and quaternion method. MATLAB was used for simulation verification. The simulation results show that the computational load of the complementary filtering algorithm is minimal, and it is easy to implement in engineering. It is especially suitable for low-cost microcontroller. Meanwhile, the error of the complementary filtering algorithm can also meet the flight requirements of system stability.

articleTitle: Measurement Method of DC Busbar Current Based on Differential Magnetic Fied
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: At present, shunts are widely used in current measurement of DC Switch Cabinet. In view of the problems of large volume, narrow measurement range and inability to realize electrical isolation, a busbar current measurement method based on differential magnetic field is proposed. The differential magnetic field is generated by adding shunt slots on the busbar and the back-end circuit is designed to reduce the influence of interference magnetic field on measurement. It has small volume and wide measurement range, strong anti-interference ability, non-contact and other characteristics. Firstly, the measurement method and anti-interference principle are analyzed theoretically, and then the bus simulation model is established in COMSOL to simulate and verify the measurement method, and the transfer relationship between magnetic field and current is calibrated by finite element method. Finally, an experimental platform for busbar current measurement is built, and the experimental results show that the error of the sensor prototype is less than 1.2%, and the influence of the interference magnetic field generated when the interference source is 25mm or more from the sensor can be ignored, which proves the accuracy and anti-interference of the measurement method.

articleTitle: Magnetorheological Damper Design and Numerical Analysis for Assistive Knee Exoskeleton
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper presents the design of MRD for assistive knee exoskeleton. The study aimed to design MRD to provide controlled and adjustable resistance to movement, primarily in the knee joint during flexion and extension to overcome excessive vibrations and shocks. Mathematical model of magnetic circuit according to Ohm’s law was developed and ANSYS (Mechanical APDL 2022 R2) was used to build an axisymmetric FEM model to analyze the magnetic flux density, magnetic field strength, and other properties of the magnetic circuit. The dynamic performance characteristics of the damper was predicted based on Bingham’s plastic model. The results demonstrated that the damper can provide a damping force of 446.6N at 1.1A current that will help to absorb and dissipate energy generated during movement, reducing impact forces and providing a smoother and more controlled motion. It will also minimize excessive vibrations and shocks, thereby improving user comfort and reducing the risk of injury.

articleTitle: Co-Simulation of Bi-Directional Pump Control Servo System Based on SimulationX and Matlab
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The traditional valve-controlled hydraulic system has the disadvantages of large energy loss, high oil temperature rise and large commutation impact. In this paper, a hydraulic system of servo motor driving bidirectional pump and controlling single rod hydraulic cylinder is proposed. Based on SimulationX and Matlab, the hydraulic circuit and control logic of the system are modeled and simulated. The performance index of the system and the running state of the main components are given. The efficiency characteristics and pressure impact characteristics of the system are studied, and a joint simulation analysis method of electromechanical hydraulic system is provided.

articleTitle: Research on Spacecraft Structural Thermal Deformation Test and Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Structural thermal stability is one of the important indexes of spacecraft structural design, which plays an important role in realizing the function and performance of spacecraft in space environment. In this paper, the thermal stability test method of large spacecraft structure under vacuum and low temperature is studied. Based on the principle of optical photography deformation measurement, the construction of the optimal deformation measurement field for large structures is realized through the innovative design of the measurement system architecture. The automation and reliability level of deformation measurement are improved through the control design of the measurement system. The system validation test and accuracy analysis method are researched. The test results show that the system can realize the transient and high-precision deformation measurement of the structure size more than 4 meters under the vacuum and low-temperature environment. The system is stable and reliable, and provides an important technical means for the correctness verification of spacecraft structure design.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis study of 25Hz phase-sensitive rail circuits based on BA-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To solve the problems of slow convergence and low diagnostic accuracy of the traditional 25Hz phase-sensitive rail circuit fault diagnosis network model, a fault diagnosis method combining the intelligent Bat Algorithm (BA) and the extended short-term memory network neural network (LSTM) is proposed. Firstly, the voltage data collected by the monitoring system is used as input to the fault diagnosis model, and an intelligent algorithm optimises the LSTM network to build a BA-LSTM model. The LSTM layer is used to mine the fault features, and finally, the classification is completed by the Softmax function to achieve intelligent fault diagnosis. The simulation results show that the accuracy is improved by 4.44% and 2.22%, respectively, compared to the GA-LSTM and PSO-LSTM comparative algorithm models, effectively improving the 25Hz phase-sensitive rail circuit fault diagnosis efficiency.

articleTitle: Method for Implementing Load Recognition Algorithm for Internet of Things Terminals Based on Distributed Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Due to the requirement of a significant amount of historical data, the current load recognition algorithms can only rely on the collection of real-time data from terminals and the utilization of cloud platforms for algorithmic computations. In light of this context, this paper first analyzes the existing hardware and software resources available in the terminals. Building upon this analysis, a load recognition algorithm based on distributed storage is proposed. The algorithm synergizes the power historical data from charging stations, communication base stations, motors, and other devices, employing hierarchical clustering and B-spline functions to decompose and recognize power curves of different load types. Finally, a simulation analysis of the load recognition algorithm is conducted on an actual power grid in Duyun, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on charging load of electric private vehicles based on charging scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the continuous development of the new energy vehicle industry, the ceiling of the B-end market such as taxis and online vehicle-hailing has gradually emerged, and electric private vehicles have gradually become the absolute main force in the new energy market, affecting the development of supporting industries. Starting from the charging scenario of electric private vehicles, based on the travel law of electric private vehicles, combined with Monte vehiclelo stochastic simulation, a charging load model that is more in line with the electricity consumption law of electric private vehicles is constructed, and the time distribution of electricity consumption per day for electric private vehicles is simulated to provide decision-making basis for relevant subjects.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-rollover Differential Braking of Heavy-dump Truck Based on Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to improve the rollover resistance of heavy dump trucks at high speeds, a three-degree-of-freedom mathematical model and a vehicle reference model were constructed. The roll state index of the lateral load transfer rate and the deviation of the vehicle center of mass side slip angle are taken as the control objectives. An anti-rollover differential braking controller is designed based on fuzzy PID control. The anti-rollover control of the vehicle is realized by differential braking to generate a yaw moment. In order to verify the effectiveness of the controller, a co-simulation was carried out in Trucksim and Matlab/Simulink, and the anti-rollover control method was verified with the fishhook working condition and step working condition. The simulation results show that the designed controller can effectively reduce the dump truck’s side slip angle, yaw rate, and peak value of the roll angle, improve the roll stability of the heavy dump truck, and reduce the rollover probability of the dump truck.

articleTitle: Wide range LLC resonant converter design and control strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Conventional LLC resonant converters have limitations in their gain characteristics and cannot operate properly in wide range input scenarios. To solve the adaptation problem of LLC resonant converter in wide input voltage range, this paper introduces a new full-bridge-half-bridge control strategy, which is based on full-bridge LLC resonant converter and can achieve stable output voltage by smoothly switching the topology between full-bridge and half-bridge. This strategy can accommodate a wide input voltage range and maintain high efficiency. In the specific implementation, the article presents and analyzes in detail the implementation principle, control algorithm and system experiments of the full-bridge-half-bridge control strategy. The method has important practical significance and engineering value, and can be widely used in power conversion systems.

Author Keywords: full bridge half bridge control strategy

articleTitle: Analysis of New Energy Oriented Electric Power Protection Service Queue Scheduling Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy equipment connected, higher requirements have been put forward for the power communication network. The existing queue scheduling algorithms are insufficient to cope with a large amount of information needs, and the concept of low latency is introduced to integrate the queue scheduling mechanism. Based on OPNET, several scheduling methods were analyzed, and the results showed that low latency queue scheduling method is more suitable for new power protection services.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Scheduling Method of Multi Cloud Collaborative Computing Network Fusion Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Conventional scheduling methods mainly focus on shortening the scheduling time, and the network resources cannot be balanced, resulting in poor scheduling results. Therefore, an intelligent scheduling method for multi cloud collaborative computing network fusion resources is designed. Construct a global Nash equilibrium of computing network integration resources, balance the resources after computing network integration, and avoid the problem of local optimal scheduling. Based on multi cloud collaboration, the resource scheduling model of computing network cloud computing is constructed to find the optimal scheduling value of resource data after computing network integration. Verify the resource scheduling consistency of the multi cloud platform, the hash function of the fixed scheduling model, and analyze the integrity of the resource scheduling data. By means of simulation experiments, it is verified that the intelligent scheduling effect of this scheduling method is more stable and can be applied to real life.

articleTitle: Mechatronic dynamics modeling and analyzing of a three degree-of-freedom high-speed parallel robot
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Considering the torsional elasticity of connecting components, the dynamics characteristics of joint transmission module of Delta robot were studied in this paper. First, by taking mechanical load as disturbances, the decoupled mechatronic dynamics model of two-mass joint transmission module was established. Based on the decoupled dynamics model, the torsional vibration and velocity transmission error of the joint transmission module were analyzed. Then, taking Delta robot as an example, dynamics feedforward and disturbance observer were proposed to improve the accuracy and reduce the velocity transmission error of joint transmission system. Results show that the torsional vibration and transmission error of joint transmission module caused by the torsional elasticity of connecting components have important impacts on the dynamics performances of the Delta robot, which should be restrained in actual motion control.

articleTitle: Design of downhole parameter measurement system for electric submersible pump
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The real-time measurement of downhole parameters of electric submersible pumps through supporting systems can monitor the production performance of oil wells and the status of electric pumps in real time, helping operators to take appropriate regulatory measures to achieve the best production results. The downhole temperature and pressure measurement system for electric submersible pump is designed based on the research on the measurement technology of downhole parameters. The system uses ground simulation star point technology to power underground circuits and current loop technology for data transmission. The system mainly includes temperature and pressure sensors, power modules, measurement circuits, filter circuits, and channel switching circuits. The work and key technologies of each functional module of the system are analyzed. The simulation test results of the downhole measurement system in the laboratory show that the system can collect downhole temperature and pressure parameters in real time, and achieve the processing of downhole temperature and pressure signals with the cooperation of the surface system. At the same time, the system can effectively suppress interference, operate stably, and meet the requirements of on-site testing and application.

articleTitle: Efficient output feedback MPC for NCS with the data dropout and bounded disturbance via adaptive event-triggered mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper studies the efficient output feedback model predictive control (OFMPC) via adaptive event-triggered mechanism for NCS with the data dropout and bounded disturbance. First, an adaptive event-triggered mechanism which utilized an adaptive threshold is considered together with the data dropout and bounded disturbance in NCS. Second, the estimator gain of state estimator is provided by solving a linear matrix inequality (LMI) which guarantees the stability of estimator error. Moreover, an off-line optimization problem is established to get the upper bound of estimator error. Then, through two off-line and one on-line optimization problems, the corresponding the efficient MPC algorithm, which increases the initial feasible set and reduce computation, is obtained. Finally, the provided algorithm about NCS is validated by simulation experiments.

Author Keywords: Efficient output feedback model predictive control

articleTitle: A digital twin model of hot rolling process based on CGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the current shortcoming of relying on online control of process parameters in hot rolling process, we proposed a digital twin model based on CGAN. This model can simulate the rolling process according to rolling information such as production conditions, working environment, material properties, and rolling sequence. For model training, testing and validation, we collected actual production data of the hot rolling mill is collected. The results show that the process parameters generated by the model are close to those of the real process, which proves it can reflect the hot rolling process and could be used for future simulation, quality prediction and production optimization of the hot rolling process.

articleTitle: Multi-signal comparison and analysis of tool wear based on EMD energy decomposition method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a comparative analysis method based on EMD energy decomposition for detecting the amount of tool wear during milling and to achieve online monitoring of tool wear status in order to ensure the quality and accuracy of products machined by machine tools and to lower the risk of damage to products and machine tools due to tool wear or breakage. Three separate sensors were employed for the planned milling experiment to gather current signal, vibration signal and sound signal respectively. The varied signal energies were then processed using the EMD energy decomposition technique, and the relationship between the outcomes and tool wear was examined.The characteristic frequency bands eventually resulted in the acquisition of six intrinsic mode function (IMF) components for three different wear periods and the energy calculation of each IMF component because the acquired signals were non-stationary and non-linear.. Finally, analysis and comparison of the overall energy distribution and trends of each roup of signals was performed. According to the experimental findings, under the identical machining settings, the vibration signals based on the EMD energy decomposition have a high correlation with tool wear, followed by the current signals, while the sound signals do not show a significant correlation with tool wear. The results of this paper have some significance for tool wear monitoring.

articleTitle: Production Scheduling Optimization Method Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the environment of smart manufacturing, smart and agile production scheduling is an important measure for manufacturing companies to meet the new trend. To solve complex production scheduling problems consisting of different optimization objectives and constraints, an optimization model is constructed, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed, and a particle selection based on the tournament selection method and a new speed update mechanism is designed. The practicality of the algorithm was verified with production data, confirming that the improved algorithm improved order completion time by 24.6% over traditional scheduling methods.

articleTitle: Gap Image Classification Based on PCA-SVM with Multiple Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The detection of gap size at the threaded connection of the inner diameter of an aviation rocket body is crucial for the performance of the body. Due to the different processing degrees of the inner diameter during processing, there are two working conditions on the inner diameter surface. The image features of the gap under these two working conditions are different. Therefore, before detecting the gap size, it is necessary to distinguish between these two working conditions. This article proposes a multi feature fusion classification method based on PCA-SVM, which takes texture features, grayscale features, and depth features as joint feature parameters of the image. The PCA algorithm is used to perform multi feature fusion on them, and the fused feature parameters are input into the training SVM classifier for training the classification network. The experiment shows that the proposed method has a classification recognition rate of 99.5% in the classification of rough and fine surfaces of aviation rockets, Providing technical support for efficient and automated production of products.

articleTitle: Kinematics modeling and simulation optimization of breast puncture robot
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to design a hybrid puncture robot specifically designed for MRI guided breast puncture surgery. The robot has five degrees of freedom and is composed of a series parallel hybrid mechanism and a 2 degree of freedom needle feeding module. Through decoupling the seriesparallel hybrid mechanism, kinematics modeling is performed, a D-H parameter relationship table is established, forward kinematics analysis and calculation are performed, and a three-dimensional workspace is drawn using Python. The robot structure is optimized based on workspace analysis. Finally, the accuracy of the robot kinematics model and the rationality of the structural design are verified using the Adams simulation results. This research provides a new idea and method for the application of robots in breast puncture surgery.

articleTitle: A path planning method for unmanned autonomous vehicles based on Improved A* algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Different kinds of unmanned autonomous vehicles need to travel at different speeds in different operations. In order to accomplish this task, a path planning algorithm is improved in this study, which can be applied to unmanned autonomous vehicles with different speed conditions This algorithm is an improvement on the traditional $\text{A}^{\star}$ path planning algorithm. Firstly, the traditional four-direction search is changed into a multi-direction search. Secondly, the restriction condition of maximum Angle is added in the process of searching adjacent points. Finally, we get A more suitable $\text{A}^{\star}$ search algorithm. Using MATLAB, the improved $\text{A}^{\star}$ algorithm can solve the path planning problem under the requirements of different speeds $(30\text{k}\text{m}/\text{h}, 45\text{k}\text{m}/\text{h},60\text{k}\text{m}/\text{h})$.

articleTitle: Research on path planning of mobile robot based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: From a certain point of view, the level of the mobile robotics field also represents the degree of development of advanced science and technology in the country. Traditional algorithms gradually show some defects with the development of the times and cannot adapt well to the complex working environment of mobile robots. The advantage of genetic algorithm is its high level of overall retrieval and good robustness, so this study chooses genetic algorithm when arranging paths for mobile robots.In this study, the scene conditions of movement are created for the mobile robot by raster map method in MATLAB software, and the adaptation level function is created with reference to the need of its movement smoothing level and route distance, and the appropriate weighting factors of smoothing level and route distance as well as the relevant parameters of genetic algorithm are found, and it is concluded that the changes of different parameters will have a large impact on the movement path of the mobile robot, and by the The adjustment of the parameters can enable the mobile robot to find the optimal path in different environments smoothly.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Electrical Load on the Fuel Consumption of Vehicles Equipped with Intelligent Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This research aims to study fuel consumption testing and energy-saving technologies based on the China light-duty vehicle test cycle-passenger (CLTC-P). A new fuel consumption testing method is proposed in this paper. The method applies a constant external load during the test to study its impact on the vehicle’s fuel consumption. The test results show that the fuel consumption increases by approximately (8.8-9.3)% when the vehicle is operating under an additional load of (45-50)A. However, the growth rate of fuel consumption decreases as the load current increases. Additionally, the study verifies that traditional vehicles equipped with intelligent generator systems have a fuel-saving effect and optimization space under different external load. This study provides a new idea for optimizing energy-saving technologies for traditional fuel vehicles and supports the evaluation standards of Off-cycle technology/device energy saving effects evaluation methods for passenger cars in the future.

articleTitle: Research And Implementation of High Precision Full Range Analog Acquisition System Based on Zero Flux Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The new generation substation has a special demand for high-precision measurement and high-performance power quality of fiscal metering units, compared with the traditional fiscal metering units, the detection current is smaller and the dynamic measurement range is wider. In order to solve the above problems, a scheme of using zero flux current transformer to collect current to ensure the effective value and phase accuracy of small current, using high-precision ADC chip in hardware, multistage current acquisition and multi-point calibration in software is proposed, complete large dynamic range current acquisition, to design method of substation fiscal metering units to realize the functions of electricity metering and power quality. Through the data acquisition of two hardware design schemes, the scheme of zero flux current transformer + multi-stage acquisition is superior to the scheme of traditional current transformer + single-stage acquisition, meetting the technology needs of a new generation of substation fiscal metering units.

articleTitle: Research on Steady-state Error of Electric Spring With Switchable Smart load under Fixed Angle Control
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of excessive steady-state error of electric spring with switchable smart load(SES), this paper introduces the concept and basic principle of SES and the definition of fixed angle, discusses the selection method of fixed angle, and discusses the switchable control strategy under fixed angle control. According to automatic control principle, the control process of SES stable different loads under fixed-angle control is analyzed and the principle of reducing steady-state error is given. Finally, with the help of MATLAB/Simulink software, it is verified that electric spring with switchable smart load under fixed-angle control can stabilize the voltage of key and non-critical loads at the same time, and is conducive to reducing the steady-state error.

articleTitle: Intelligent control of chain tension of mining scraper conveyor based on fuzzy adaptive algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The current tension control of scraper chains mainly relies on load prediction algorithms, but this method is easily affected by the resistance value of the bottom chain, resulting in a high overshoot after control. Therefore, an intelligent control of chain tension for mining scraper conveyors based on fuzzy adaptive algorithm is proposed. According to the automatic adjustment principle of the tension of the scraper conveyor chain, the constitutive model of the chain is divided into multiple discrete tension units to construct a dynamic model of the chain transmission. Combined with the linear density function of the circular chain material, the resistance value of the bottom chain is calculated, and based on the internal width matrix of the chain, the chain tension is calculated. Based on this, a fuzzy adaptive algorithm is used to design the controller, and the parameters of the controller are automatically adjusted, Make the tension control value infinitely close to the expected value in the near future, thereby achieving intelligent control of the tension of the scraper chain. The test results show that the control overshoot of the proposed method is low and the control effect is good.

articleTitle: Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm Based on Multi Strategy Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The Integrated Strategy Sparrow Search Algorithm (ISSA) has been developed as an advanced optimization algorithm to enhance solution accuracy, stability, and to address local optima issues associated with the conventional Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA). The ISSA algorithm incorporates various strategies, including a chaotic lens strategy, the Golden Sinusoidal Algorithm (GSA), and an adaptive control parameter $\eta$ based on gamma distribution, to augment population diversity, search coverage, exploration, and development capabilities. The performance of the ISSA algorithm has been evaluated using 12 benchmark functions, which demonstrate that the ISSA algorithm outperforms the basic SSA algorithm, other improved algorithms, as well as other swarm intelligence optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Arrangement Method for The Case with Mixed Cables and Overhead Lines Based on Center of Gravity Inspiration Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to fix the problems of having crossing points and uneven branch line length distribution in the existing algorithm for the intelligent arrangement of the case with mixed cables and overhead lines, a method of center of gravity inspiration method combined with particle swarm optimization is proposed. Firstly, the method determines the preliminary arrangement of the transmission lines based on the multi-branch tree traversal. On this basis, the symmetry relationship of the branch line is optimized by the center of gravity inspiration method. Finally, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the key parameters of the center of gravity inspiration method to further reduce the number of crossing points and improve the uniformity of the branch line length. The multi-branch tree method, the common information model method, the substation configuration description file method and the proposed method are used for the intelligent arrangement of a 110 kV system with mixed cables and overhead lines, and the proposed method is validated.

articleTitle: Test and analysis of new energy vehicle HV transient waveform
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: New energy vehicles will generate different HV (high-voltage) transient signals in different working conditions, which pose a threat to the electromagnetic safety of the vehicle. Collection of HV transient waveforms is performed in different new energy vehicles and different working states, and the worst HV transient waveforms are formed by analyzing the data of the collected waveform. The worst HV transient waveforms are used as test signals. The test results show that in a specific state, new energy vehicles have certain immunity to HV transient signals. The methods and data formed during the research process can provide support for the R&D verification tests of enterprises and the formulation of national standards.

articleTitle: A dynamic model for the electromechanical coupling of the ball screw feed system
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The efficiency of computer numerical control (CNC) machine tools is directly associated with the machine’s ball screw feed system (BSFS). The electromechanical coupling effect of the mechanical structure and the servo system affects the system’s performance. The present study reported a mathematical model for explaining the electromechanical coupling effect by mathematically associating the servo system and the mechanical structure using MATLAB/Simulink. By adding a sinusoidal signal as an input signal in MATLAB/Simulink, the acceleration signals of BSFS were obtained by adjusting the frequency of the input signal. The electromechanical coupling model is verified by simulation and experiments. The simulation results showed that the frequency and amplitude are directly related. No significant difference was noticed between the generated “peak” frequency and the input signal frequency. It is shown that the errors between experimental results and theoretical ones are 16.8% and 2%, respectively, which is acceptable and verifies this established electromechanical coupling model.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation design of temperature control system based on 51 single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper presents a temperature control system that utilizes the AT89C51 microcontroller as its control core. The system collects and converts temperature data through the use of a DS18B20 temperature sensor. The paper provides detailed explanations of the system scheme design, hardware design, and software design, with simulation tests conducted using Keil software and Proteus software to verify the scientific nature of the system and the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault diagnosis based on convolution Neural Network with Multi-Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the case of load changes and noise interference environment, the single convolutional neural network(CNN) has insufficient ability to extract key features, which makes the fault diagnosis accuracy of the network model low. In order to improve the ability of convolution neural network to obtain characteristic information in interference environment, and then improve the diagnostic accuracy of bearings. In this paper, a fault diagnosis model combining convolution neural network and bidirectional gated cyclic network (BiGRU) is proposed. In this model, the channel attention mechanism is used to optimize the learning mechanism of convolutional neural network, and BiGRU network is used to extract the timing feature information of vibration signals. Then self attention mechanism is used to filter the important feature information, and finally the fault diagnosis results are output at the full connection layer. The experimental results show that, under the condition of variable load, the average accuracy of convolution neural network with multi-attention mechanism is as high as 97.17%. In the case of noise interference, the accuracy rate is as high as 99.43%. The convolutional neural network with multiple attention mechanisms can effectively resist the interference of load changes and noise, and greatly improve the ability of the convolutional neural network to extract key information.

articleTitle: Design of incremental PID intelligent irrigation control system
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Incremental PID intelligent irrigation control system using STC89C52 single-chip microcomputer connected to YL-69 humidity sensing module for soil humidity data collection, using incremental PID control algorithm to adjust PWM, intelligent speed regulation of DC motor of the pump, so that soil humidity is kept at a constant set value, LabVIEW is used to monitor the control algorithm, through experiments show that the use of incremental PID adjustment can make the system respond quickly and have certain stability. The control system enables precise irrigation, which not only saves energy and reduces emissions, but also maintains the optimum humidity in the soil, thereby increasing crop yields.

articleTitle: Analysis of preheating process on the thermal performance of multi-effect evaporation for seawater desalination
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In this work, three conventional feeding arrangements of multi-effect evaporation systems (forward-feed, parallel-feed, backward-feed) without preheater are studied. The results show that the feedwater temperature of the first effect is too low for the forward-feed and parallel-feed processes to affect the system performance. So it is considered that adding preheating process in the conventional forward-feed and parallel-feed. Compared with the previous work, the influence of preheating position and preheater number on the system performance is studied. It showed that compared with the system without preheating, the Gained output ratio (GOR) increased and the specific heat transfer $(A_{\mathrm{s}})$ decreased. After the number of preheaters is determined, preheating positions have important effects on thermal performance. As the preheating position moved backward, the GOR of the forward-feed system increased first and then decreased, and the $A_{\mathrm{s}}$ showed a linear increase trend. Both the GOR and $A_{\mathrm{s}}$ of the parallel-feed system increase first and then decrease. Last, the performance of five multi-effect evaporation systems, including forward-feed (F-MEE), forward-feed with preheating (PF-MEE), parallel feed (P-MEE), parallel feed with preheating (PP-MEE), and backward-feed (B-MEE) are compared which provides theoretical guidance for the selection of high efficiency and energy saving systems.

articleTitle: Research on Corrosion Rate Prediction of Buried Pipeline Based on KPCA-Improved PSO-BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Corrosion will damage the structure of buried pipeline and lead to its failure. Corrosion rate varies with different soil properties. In order to predict the corrosion rate of buried pipeline accurately and reliably, KPCA- improved PSO-BPNN prediction model is proposed. In this paper, a buried oil pipeline section in Shaanxi Province is selected for research. Firstly, an 8-dimensional external corrosion index system is constructed. Secondly, in order to improve the fitting effect and remove redundant information, KPCA is introduced for preprocessing to obtain a 6-dimensional index system. Thirdly, BPNN is optimized by PSO algorithm with improved weight parameters, and corrosion rate is predicted through training. Finally, by comparing the prediction accuracy of single BPNN, KPCA-BPNN and KPCA-improved PSO-BPNN model, it is found that the accuracy of KPCA-improved PSO-BPNN model can reach 94.73%, which is 13.26% and 8.04% higher than the previous two models respectively. Therefore, the proposed new model can better meet the actual engineering requirements.

articleTitle: Substation Digital Patrol Route Optimization Based on Differential Evolution Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the continuous progress of digitization in the power industry, the construction of a digital patrol system has become one of the keys of digital production. Traditional patrol algorithm has low accuracy of patrol route, global path planning and local path planning cannot be unified, and patrol path is affected by important parameters. To overcome these shortcomings, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm based on differential evolution is presented in this paper. It has the advantages of searching ability and a strong iteration effect, and after several iterations, it integrates the local path with global path, and the shortest distance is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Combination Relationship Prediction of Kaplan Turbine based on Radical Basis Function Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of Kaplan turbine, it is necessary to optimize the calculation method of combination relationship. In this paper, radical basis function neural network is used to establish the prediction model of the combination relationship of Kaplan turbine, and the measured combination relationship data is used to train the model, then the optimal combination relationship prediction model of the turbine is obtained. According to example, the combination relationship of the turbine under a certain head is predicted, and the predicted results are consistent with the measured values. Compared with the traditional linear interpolation method, the average relative error of radical basis function results is less than the latter. This paper provides a method to accurately predict the combination relationship of Kaplan turbine.

articleTitle: Optimization of UAV Coverage Efficiency Based on Improved Random Wandering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the rapid deployment of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and the terrain-independent benefits of UAVs make them important in aiding communication. The current research related to UAV-assisted communication stays at the single UAV stage, and the cooperative operation of multiple UAVs has a great advantage in information perception and mission accomplishment efficiency compared with a single UAV. However, multiple UAVs are faced with the problems of coverage efficiency and communication delay, and quality that are difficult to be achieved at the same time. Therefore, an optimization scheme is proposed to address the problem of communication delay reduction caused by the increase of area coverage efficiency when multiple UAV operate cooperatively. The scheme can maximize the coverage efficiency while ensuring that the communication delay satisfies the constraints through an improved random wandering algorithm with the introduction of goal orientation. The experimental results show that the improved random wandering algorithm can coordinate the number of iterations and the optimal solution space size, and can determine the optimal value of step λ to achieve the best balance of UAV coverage efficiency and communication quality and time delay.

articleTitle: A Revenue Distribution Strategy for Distributed Thermal-Electrical Coupled Consumers
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In recent years, due to the rapid growth of new energy installed capacity, the electricity consumption situation is getting tougher. In view of the serious wind abandonment phenomenon in northern China during the winter heating season, this paper investigates the operating mechanism of combined electric storage heaters with wind power consumption in electricity market. Considering the effects of operating power of electric storage heaters and the positive and negative reserve capacities, this paper proposes a revenue distribution strategy for the electric storage heaters when participating in spot market transactions with new energy generators. And the effectiveness of the strategy is verified by a case.

articleTitle: Vibration Mode and Dynamics Response Analysis for TBM 3-Stage Planetary Reducer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The planetary reducers, which make up the core component of the main drive system of TBM, should highly reliable to meet the national strategic engineering requirements. In order to avoid the resonance in operating, the vibration mode, dynamic excitations and dynamic response of the newly designed TBM 3-stage planetary reducer are carried out in this paper. Firstly, the analysis model of planetary reducer is built to calculate the support stiffness of bearings and mesh stiffness of each meshing pair. Secondly, the finite element model of planetary reducer and boundary conditions are set up to analysis the vibration mode. Finally, the dynamic response of planetary reducer is calculated by mode superposition method in FE model. As shown in results, the possibility of resonance of TBM 3-stage planetary reducer is low in different working conditions, where the vibration response value appears at the meshing frequency of the gear system and its multiples.

articleTitle: The study on operation characteristics of bidirectional fan
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In this paper, a bidirectional fan used in grain storage and the HVAC field is studied. The internal flow field of two-way fan is analyzed by CFD numerical simulation. At the same time, the performance curve of the fan is calculated by numerical simulation combined with experimental verification. The influences of parameters such as the number of blades and blade Angle on the air volume, static pres, sure and noise value of the fan are studied respectively under positive and reverse conditions. The results show that there is a certain reflux phenomenon at the inlet of the two-way fan, which leads to the decrease of the fan air volume. At the same time, the maximum air volume, the maximum outlet static pressure and the noise of the fan increase with the increase of the number of fan blades. In addition, the Angle of the blade is related to the ratio of positive rotation and positive rotation air volume. When the Angle of the blade increases from 0° to 15°, the ratio of the maximum inversion air volume to the maximum positive rotation air volume decreases from 74.6% to 38.8%.

articleTitle: Research on automotive balance chair posture control based on cascade PID
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to adjust the vehicle sway and height imbalance caused by uneven road surface, turning, starting acceleration, braking, etc. during the movement of the carrier, the problem of motion sickness is effectively solved to some extent. Therefore, a development seat balance control system and seat balance control mechanism are designed. With STM32-F4 series as the core board, the stepper motor is further angularly regulated using a series-level PID based on the acquired dynamic gyroscope data information. After observing the angle simulation curve to match the target value and the actual object verification, it can be seen that the proposed scheme of this design effectively improves the comfort, safety performance during the driving process of the car, and provides support for the research of the automotive industry class.

articleTitle: Wireless Monitoring System for Bridge Turning Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: For cross-obstacle bridges such as those along railroads, turning construction is one of its important construction methods, and instability exists during the construction process, which requires construction monitoring, but the traditional monitoring methods have defects such as low accuracy and cannot be monitored remotely. To this end, a bridge inclination and ball-hinged stress monitoring system is designed. In this paper, the ARM processor STM32 is used as the core, combined with RS485 and 4G communication to achieve the sensor signal acquisition system hardware design, using MODBUS communication protocol for data communication to ensure the reliability of communication. And the system is tested in the built system test platform to check its stability and accuracy. The experimental results show that the accuracy as well as the stability of the bridge monitoring system in this paper meet the practical application requirements, and this study can provide technical support for the real-time detection of bridge turnings and the rapid calibration and testing of strain monitoring sensors before installation.

articleTitle: A Design Scheme for Reducing Power Consumption of Domestic Intelligent Electricity Meter
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to achieve the low power requirements of the new smart electricity meter, reduce the terminal power consumption and prolong the battery power service time, this paper designed and implemented a smart electricity meter to reduce the power consumption. The scheme is designed to reduce static power consumption and dynamic power consumption. Static power consumption reduction is mainly due to the consideration of device selection, while dynamic power consumption is mainly achieved by setting low power mode and switching between different working modes.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of flow field in vertical condensate pump
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As a kind of fluid mechanical equipment, water pumps are widely used in various fields such as water conservancy, petrochemicals, and energy. This article simulates and studies the flow field and pressure field of a certain multi-stage condensate pump, exploring the mechanism and characteristics of internal flow in the pump. The research results show that the water flow can obtain a certain degree of pressure increase after passing through each impeller. However, there is elbow loss at the connection between each impeller. Due to the complex structure between the first-stage impeller and the second-stage impeller, the pressure loss is the largest with a value of 2,238,490Pa. The water flow from the inlet to the outlet of the condensate pump accumulates a pressure boost of 1,523,042Pa.

articleTitle: Coherent Accumulation Optimization of External Radar Signals Based on CUDA
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Because of its anti-stealth and anti-jamming characteristics, external emitter radar has attracted extensive attention of military experts in the world. However, there are a lot of parallel operations in the signal processing process of multi station combined external emitter radar. The traditional digital signal processor not only has long development cycle and high cost, but also has defects in the real-time and stability of signal processing. This project mainly designs the signal coherent accumulation process of external emitter radar based on “CPU + GPU”, and transplants the signal processing process of external emitter radar to CUDA platform. This paper focuses on the matching filter unit in the signal processing step of the external emitter radar, and then shows the CUDA optimization method of the matching filter unit in signal coherence accumulation. Through the advantages of CUDA architecture in parallel computing, the processing time of signal coherent accumulation can be greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Servo Antenna Equipment Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The deceleration curve of vehicle emergency braking conditions during equipment transportation was collected, and the structural strength and stiffness of the servo equipment were analyzed and optimized. The finite element analysis results indicate that in the case of emergency braking of transportation vehicles, the base part of the servo equipment is prone to plastic deformation, and the structure needs to be optimized and strengthened. Based on engineering experience, modifications have been made to the servo equipment base. Simulation was conducted on the improved structure, and the results showed that some optimized servo base structures met the design requirements for stiffness and strength.

articleTitle: Redundant control of IPMSM at zero low speed based on high frequency signal injection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A new method for position sensorless control with randomly injected high-frequency square wave signal injection is investigated in order to reduce the noise impact attached to the conventional high-frequency signal injection method as software redundancy in practical applications of electric vehicles. The method improves the spectral concentration problem caused by the traditional fixed switching probability method by varying the switching probability in real time, and then eliminates the use of low-pass filters in the traditional method by means of an improved filter-free signal separation strategy that takes into account the sampling delay, increasing the control bandwidth of the system while reducing the estimated rotor position error. Simulation results show that the proposed method has both good noise reduction performance and observation accuracy.

articleTitle: Construction of the Campus Body Temperature Screening System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, it is increasingly important to detect human body temperature in public places on campus. Based on this demand, the dissertation establishes an artificial intelligence campus body temperature screening system. The paper first builds the overall architecture of the system. Using infrared thermal imaging equipment to measure the temperature and real-time monitoring of the campus. Then, the infrared thermal imaging is composed of the infrared thermal imaging to introduce the hardware composition of the system. Putting a method of temperature correction. Finally, the face detection algorithm is designed to improve the MTCNN network model. The algorithm is improved by detecting facial losses, and the losses of the frame return, face classification and key point positioning are conducted for network model training. At the end of the article, the accuracy of the improvement method was greatly improved through the experimental comparison.

articleTitle: Hardware-in-the-loop Simulation System Design of Marine Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The onshore engine room currently serves as the most practical teaching and research platform for marine engineering. However, it faces challenges such as environmental pollution, high construction costs, and difficulties in ensuring personnel safety. To address these issues, this paper establishes a hardware-in-the-loop simulation system for the onshore engine room. The actual diesel engine is replaced with a physical model, offering solutions to many of the traditional engine room problems. Additionally, software integrated with the HIL system is developed to display parameters and diagrams. A GT-Power model is constructed for the diesel engine to simulate its running parameters. The simulation results are compared with diesel engine test reports, and critical parameters like compression pressure and peak pressure exhibit errors of $\leq 5\%$, meeting the simulation requirements. The feasibility of this hardware-in-theloop simulation system is verified, which significantly enhances safety, economic efficiency, and the repeatability of acquiring research data compared to traditional onshore automatic engine rooms.

articleTitle: Air conditioning fan optimization based on improved SO algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper studied the air handling system with high internal energy consumption in air conditioning system. Most variable-frequency fans in the system were controlled by PID controller. At present, algorithms applied to PID controller emerge in endlessly. Most algorithms were either too complex, or had too many iterations and taken too long to calculate. This paper attempted to use a new simple and effective SO(Snake optimizer) algorithm to control, and analyzed its control and energy-saSving effect.

articleTitle: Quantifying PV system power loss based on soiling index of PV system diode model and soiling nonuniformity distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The photovoltaic system usually works in the outdoor environment, and the atmospheric environment contains different types of dust particles, especially in the desert, the Gobi, and other areas. although the sunshine resources are rich, the surface of the photovoltaic module system is easy to deposit dust by wind sand, dust, and other environmental particles interference yearly, which could lead to reduce the overall power generation of the photovoltaic system. In the actual installation site of the photovoltaic system, the installation method of the PV module and the climate characteristics of the project site, the accumulation of dust on the surface of the PV module distribute by nonuniformity distribution characteristics. In the current research on the influence of soiling on photovoltaic system, there is no detailed study on the influence of uneven distribution of soling on the power loss of photovoltaic system. In this paper, a novel simulation method is proposed. Firstly, the two-diode PV model is used to characterize the electrical characteristics of the module, and secondly, the pollution index of the module cell is defined. Finally, the user-defined soiling uneven distribution case is used to quantify the degree of power loss of photovoltaic system.

articleTitle: Study and Development of Intelligent KPI Management System for Discrete Manufacturing Enterprises in Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Key performance indicators (KPIs) are essential for manufacturing management and production optimization in discrete manufacturing enterprises. In the context of Industry 4.0, KPI management in discrete manufacturing enterprises struggles in obtaining large amounts of heterogeneous data, low transmission efficiency and poor real-time KPI evaluation. Towards the above-mentioned problems, this paper investigates the definition and characteristics of intelligent KPI management system in discrete manufacturing enterprises and designs a distributed application architecture of the system based on OPC UA protocol. On this basis, the system node functions and the production site deployment of the nodes are designed according to the production organization structure of the enterprises, to achieve accurate KPI real-time evaluation. Moreover, intelligent KPI optimization support is designed, which provides intelligent KPI optimization recommendation based on KPI optimization experience and optimization knowledge, as well as optimization task management for real-time tracking of optimization tasks. Finally, we adopt the Spring Boot framework to develop the cloud-intelligent KPI management system, which provides enterprise managers with a visual approach to digitally and intelligently manage KPIs.

articleTitle: Research on the application of transmission line path optimization based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: the transmission line line path optimization application research, its main research purpose is, the power corridor multiple space information as the basic structure, and cost optimization and sensitive area for the principle, and with the help of GIS system, from the geographical space comprehensive analysis of the best transmission line path, realize the intelligent transmission line line, automation selection, and for the future transmission line line path optimization research provide important reference basis. And GIS as a computer hard, software system support, for the whole or part of the earth surface (including the atmosphere) in the geographical distribution data collection, storage, management, operation, analysis, display and description of the technical system, its own characteristics of geographical space intelligence, provides great help for the most research, not only guarantee the authenticity and comprehensiveness of the research, but also improve the practical value of the research content, is the current many geological research, information technology research and one of the main application system of power system research.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Numerical Press Equipment Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The design and application of numerical pressing machine are studied. Based on electromechanical hydraulic principle, combined with hydraulic transmission, electrical control, mechanical design simulation research methods, through the analysis of the movement and functional requirements of the press, the design calculation is carried out to form a complete set of hydraulic principle, electrical principle and mechanical structure, to achieve the movement of the press machine and various functions. By studying the design and application of numerical press-mounting equipment, a set of modern industrial equipment which can switch fast forward, work forward and fast back action instructions, can display pressure information in real time, and can realize overcurrent and overvoltage protection is developed, which provides certain guiding significance for the application of modern industrial press-mounting equipment.

articleTitle: Combined GNSS/INS positioning scheme with the introduction of virtual transponders
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The existing train positioning technology of the train control system relies on the track circuit, which has high construction and operation and maintenance costs. the GNSS/INS system can effectively improve the train positioning accuracy, but the global satellite navigation technology has the problem of signal loss in the complex operation environment, which increases the cumulative error of the inertial measurement unit. To meet the demand of future train results, this paper proposes a combined GNSS/INS positioning scheme that introduces a virtual transponder to calibrate the cumulative error of inertial measurement units. The proposed combination is simulated and tested, and the results show that the combined positioning system converges significantly in the train speed error as well as the mileage error, and can provide continuous high accuracy positioning for trains.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle ramp adaptive torque regulation starting control strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
