abstract: Aiming at the phenomenon of slope slipping when electric vehicle starts on the ramp, an adaptive torque regulation starting control strategy is adopted, which can improve the vehicle starting stability, reduce the vehicle slope distance and effectively avoid the occurrence of safety hazards. The control system uses the vehicle controller to collect the vehicle information and make a judgment on the driving conditions, and if it meets the hill-stop condition, it sends the hill-stop torque signal to the motor controller, which controls the motor to output the hill-stop torque. The standing slope torque value is estimated jointly by the extended Kalman filter algorithm for the vehicle mass and slope value, and the standing slope torque to keep the vehicle stationary on the slope is calculated according to the estimated value, and then the output torque is adjusted by the integral separation PI for torque compensation to adjust the motor output torque in real time to reduce the slope distance when starting and realize the smooth starting of the vehicle. The adaptive start simulation model of electric vehicle is built by MATLAB/Simulink and simulated jointly with Carsim. The simulation results show that the control strategy can make the vehicle start smoothly and meet the requirements of safe start, which verifies the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Visual Error Proofing System on Automatic Production Line Based on Halon
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The research on error proof detection technology of automatic assembly line is of great significance to improve the product qualification rate and production efficiency. In the traditional automatic production line, the installation of workpieces is still manual operation, which will lead to the problem of wrong tooling and wrong workpiece installation. This leads to various error risks in the manufacturing process of single line and multiple varieties, such as parts scrapping, machine tool damage, etc., thus increasing the manufacturing cost of parts. Therefore, this paper is based on c++ language and MFC platform and visual software Halcon jointly design and develop visual error proofing detection system, which includes software and hardware. In the software part, multiple feature points are extracted through image processing, and these features are used for template matching, and the template matching is optimized. In order to improve the matching speed, the matching parameter pyramid layers and greediness are tested, and finally the matching parameters most suitable for the automatic production line are obtained, so that the system can quickly identify installation errors; In the hardware part, a PLC controlled rotating mechanism is designed. Through the design of error proofing experiment, it is verified that the error proofing system designed in this paper can quickly detect the parts with installation errors. The identification speed of the error proofing system designed in this paper reaches 20ms/part, and the average identification accuracy of the parts reaches more than 99.8%, which is superior to the traditional manual identification. The system has fast speed and high precision, and can meet the requirements of industrial production. The system can alarm in time after the installation errors are found, It greatly reduces the quality loss caused by incorrect installation of parts and reduces the manufacturing cost of parts.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage BESSs Planning Method in Distribution Networks Considering Dynamic Network Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: When the dynamic network reconfiguration (DNR) is considered, the planning of the battery energy storage system (BESS) is converted from a mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problem to a larger one. To make the problem tractable, this paper proposes a novel two-stage solution method. In the first stage, to adapt to the dual attributes of BESS and the objective, a comprehensive cost sensitivity factor (CCSF) is presented. In the second stage, to reduce the size of sizing optimization and find a better solution, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is adopted for sizing optimization, and the Minty algorithm combined with a heuristic strategy is applied for DNR. Numerical simulations on an IEEE standard 69-bus system shows the superiority of the proposed algorithm over existing methods.

articleTitle: Residual life prediction method of roll-packing units based on multi-component vibration model and CIndRNN neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The degradation information, such as vibration and wear, of the equipment components in the roll-packing units and their production and operation data have a significant impact on predicting the residual life and maintenance cycle of the whole machine. Such factors also seriously affect the formulation of equipment maintenance cost quotas. This paper presents a multi-component vibration model that generates the cumulative vibration displacement of vulnerable components as the key feature dataset based on damage accumulation theory. The model fuses this dataset with two other feature datasets, namely the specified model output and startup time. A Convolutional Independent Recurrent Neural Network (CIndRNN) model is established based on multivariate sequence input and local feature learning to accurately predict the residual life of the roll-packing units. Using the ZB45 SB#3 machine as an example, the results show that this method can reflect the correlation between the diverse influencing factors and the prediction object. Furthermore, the residual life prediction value of the unit is positively correlated with the yield, and the prediction error is only 3.4%. This method provides an algorithmic basis for accurately predicting the residual life of the roll-packing units, and reasonably formulating the equipment maintenance cost quota standard.

articleTitle: Structural performance optimization of electric air conditioning compressor
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The compressor is the core component of the air conditioning system, and when the compressor is operating, its rotor will generate a large centrifugal force during high-speed rotation, while the rotor balance system has a significant impact on the natural frequency of the overall structure. This paper models the rotor system, and performs modal analysis on the rotor based on Ansys to obtain the first four natural frequencies of the rotor. The results show that its natural frequencies are similar, which is prone to cause resonance. Through structural optimization, A vibration acceleration sensor was used to complete a vibration comparison test of the prototype on a vibration test bench at 4000 r/min, combining the vibration acceleration and natural frequency changes before and after optimization. The results show that the optimized compressor can effectively reduce vibration while ensuring the performance of the entire machine.

Author Keywords: Compressor rotor vibration ANSYS modal spectrum

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Driving Power Based on Resonance Frequency Tracking Method with Variable Step Size
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the ultrasonic driving power system for ultrasonic cleaning, the natural resonance frequency will drift as the depth in water variation of the piezoelectric transducer. Then, the efficiency of the power supply will decrease because of the detuning state. To solve this detuning problem, a resonance frequency tracking method with variable step size is adopted in this paper. By measuring the output current from full bridge inverter and DC source, and adjusting the output frequency of the power supply with variable step size, the current ratio between them is minimized, which makes the power return to resonant state and improves its efficiency. Finally, the series resonant frequency tracking experiments are carried out against different depths in water of piezoelectric transducer by a prototype setup. The test results show that the power can track the series resonant frequency effectively with different depths in water by the proposed method. Moreover, the efficiency of the overall power increases up to 14.06%.

articleTitle: Research on the optimal scheduling of integrated energy system in the park based on master-slave game
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of China’s energy revolution and the goal of “carbon peaking and carbon neutral” by 2020, it has become an unstoppable trend for new energy sources to shift from supplementary power sources to main power sources, and the energy system is under pressure to ensure energy security, improve energy efficiency and promote new energy consumption. This paper presents the problem of optimal scheduling of the integrated energy system of the park. A game theory approach to engineering management is used, with the upper-level problem targeting the lowest overall dispatch revenue cost of the integrated energy system and the lower-level problem for electrical and thermal balance. An upper-lower stackelberg model is created, The master-slave game framework is embedded in the proposed model, and the system power balance constraint and thermal energy balance constraint are also considered, And the existence and uniqueness of the Stackelberg equilibrium solution is proved. Finally, the simulation analysis is carried out using particle swarm algorithm and CPLEX solver. The algorithm shows that the game optimization can reduce the scheduling cost and improve the user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Hardware Circuit Design of Multi-Purpose Controller for Engine Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The diesel engine is the main power plant of a ship. Retraining marine engineers on diesel engines holds significant importance in maintaining the safety of navigation. At present, in the onshore engine room where Marine engineers are trained, the diesel engine mostly uses the real object, which has the problems of high pollution and high cost. To address these issues, this paper introduces an Engine Control System and designs a Multi-Purpose Controller using AD23, which is used for signal receiving, processing, and sending. The system not only provides a simulated environment for diesel engines but also offers interactivity and real-time capabilities. Through this system, Marine engineers can perform various operation and maintenance tasks in a virtual environment.

articleTitle: Research on BDS Train Location Based on HMM Map Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of traditional BDS/INS integrated navigation that affect the accuracy of train positionings, such as satellite reception signal loss and inertial navigation error accumulation over time, a hidden Markov model based on the train integrated positioning method is proposed. Firstly, establish a hidden Markov chain model using the geometric data and topological matrix of railway line nodes. Secondly, using the original positioning data as a sequence of observations, the output matrix and state transition matrix are calculated to match the orbital electronic map. Finally, the Viterbi algorithm obtains the optimal line link sequence for train trajectory matching and positioning. The simulation results show that the average position error of the train during operation is within 2m, which is smaller than using the BDS/INS combination positioning method directly. The positioning trajectory is continuous, and this algorithm can accurately predict the train’s running trajectory, improving the accuracy and accuracy of train positioning.

articleTitle: Research on High Precision Detection Algorithms for Complex Harmonics Containing Interharmonics in Double-High Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to accurately detect the complex harmonic components containing inter-harmonics in the double-high distribution network system, a harmonic detection algorithm based on Nuttall double-window full-phase FFT triple-spectral interpolation is proposed. Using a single-phase series-excited motor as a typical harmonic source, the fundamental structure of its inverter speed control system and the mechanism of harmonic generation are studied, as well as the motor’s principal harmonic components. For better detection of grid harmonics, the algorithm is based on the ideal sidelobe characteristics of the Nuttall window function, on the basis of the windowed interpolation Fast Fourier Transform algorithm, combined with all-phase FFT and three-spectral line interpolation algorithms, using the advantages of all-phase FFT phase spectrum invariance and high accuracy of the interpolation algorithm, to improve the detection accuracy of harmonics in double-high distribution network systems. MATLAB simulation analysis demonstrates that, in comparison to other harmonic detection algorithms, the algorithm described in this paper is able to maintain high accuracy in the presence of complex harmonic and white noise signals.

articleTitle: Design Optimization and Improvement of Water Cooling jacket Based on ANSYS Workbench
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Water cooling jacket has been widely used in petroleum, chemical, food, energy and other industries. In the exhaust gas treatment device of the chemical experimental platform, bulge phenomenon was found in the inner cylinder. This paper completed the analysis and calculation by ANSYS Workbench and completed the upgrade and optimization of the water cooling jacket structure. At present, the optimization mechanism has been upgraded and reformed, and passed the test and inspection, and provided a number of engineering experiment data, for the reference of relevant technical designers.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of applying pressure regulation valve to hydro turbine governing system and its multi-objective control optimization under load rejection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Pressure regulation valve is taking a growth share of the hydropower market due to its low construction cost, short construction period and high maintenance convenience, the control problem of pressure regulation valve is attracting more and more attentions in the engineering community. This paper studies the integrated control law of pressure regulation valve and guide vane in hydropower stations. Firstly, a refined hydro-turbine governing system model is established to describe the nonlinear hydro-mechanical-electrical characteristics of the system as well as the hydraulic characteristics of pressure regulation valve. Then, the effectiveness of applying pressure regulation valve to hydropower stations is validated via comparative simulations. Result indicates that pressure regulation is able to significantly reduce the pressure oscillations in volute but has little effect on the draft tube pressure. Then, a novel multi-objective optimization strategy for the joint operation of pressure regulation valve and guide vane is proposed, which optimize rotational speed and volute pressure. Optimization result indicates that the control performance can be significantly improved by the proposed optimization strategy, the optimized joint operation scheme reduces the maximum increase of volute pressure and rotational speed by 29.8 and 5.9%, respectively.

articleTitle: Internal Flow Law and Numerical Simulation Analysis of Centrifugal Pump
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Centrifugal pump, referred to as the “heart” of liquid conveying system, is a strategic equipment of national security and is utilized extensively across a variety of industries. In order to analyze the flow law of liquid inside the pump and the practical application effect in the production process of the traditional pump, The numerical simulation method is adopted in place of the traditional model experiment to analyze the flow law of the liquid inside the pump and the practical application effect in the production process of the conventional pump. This method greatly shortens the development cycle of the pump, lowers the cost of research and development costs, and enhances the design quality of the pump. This paper is based on the SST k-$\omega$) model closed Reynolds mean equation, and the centrifugal pump was designed using ANSYS FLUENT software, under flow conditions for numerical simulation, analysis of the centrifugal pump’s internal flow law and performance curve modification. It is found that when the flow rate is $20\text{m}^{\wedge}3/\text{h}$, the efficiency is at its highest on the surface. The distribution of pressure outlet is uniform, and the velocity direction is compatible with the pressure field distribution.

articleTitle: Research and simulation of Spiral squeeze and rub type corn threshing machine base on STM32 sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: At present, in our country, the traditional manual feeding method is used to collect corn grains, and then the thresher is used to thresh the corn grains. This way affects the life of thresher and the degree of corn threshing, and also causes serious damage to corn grains. It takes time and effort to thresh corn by traditional threshing method, but it can not guarantee that corn can survive breeding under the strong strike. The results need to be tested. Therefore, the automatic screw extrusion corn thresher is designed and designed based on STM32 sensor to realize feeding automation, This paper studies the research direction of the automatic screw extrusion and kneading corn thresher, and the STM32 controller system to realize the automatic feeding of the corn thresher. Then, The objective and controllable factors affecting the work of the automatic screw extrusion and thresher are studied. The calculation of the automatic screw extrusion and kneading corn threshing machine is also studied the simulation algorithm of time step of the machine can understand the productivity of corn drum falling. At the same time, the paper analyzes the net and crushing rate of corn by simulating the traditional thresher and the automatic screw extrusion corn thresher. The results show that the rate of the threshing of the automatic corn thresher (ACT) is 94.37 under the threshing condition of 200kg corn of the same group, while the net removal rate of the traditional corn thresher is only 88.42. In terms of crushing rate, the ACT is only 1.82, and the traditional corn thresher is 4.11.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of residual stress of shaft parts based on ultrasonic extrusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: An ultrasonic extrusion process for 304 stainless steel was put forward. And an ultrasonic extrusion model was established by means of finite element simulation to study the effect of different process parameters on the distribution of residual stress on the surface of shaft parts. The variation of surface residual stress and its variation along the depth of residual stress were observed and analyzed. The simulation results show that the residual compressive stress and stress depth increase with the increase of extrusion volume, amplitude and number of extrusion. And they decrease with the increase of feed speed and spindle speed. The distribution of residual stress was simulated by ultrasonic extrusion, which provided the technological guidance for the following experiments.

articleTitle: Research on the Configuration Optimization of the Storage System with Liftable Shuttles
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: According to the “cross-layer and cross-column” operation mode of the liftable shuttle, combined with the composition characteristics of the storage system, a multi-objective model for the configuration optimization of the lifting shuttles storage system is designed, which is with the objective functions including the construction and operating costs and the average throughput time, and the decision-making variables including the number of shelf layers, columns, rows, the number of shuttle vehicles, and the shuttle operation parameters. Based on a fast nondominated multi-objective optimization algorithm with elite retention strategy, the optimal solution set Pareto frontier is obtained. The research conclusion of decision-making variables parameters provides an effective reference for enterprises to make decision of planning layout and equipment selection of the actual different storage systems.

articleTitle: Research on a PLZT ceramic-based slanted-lower-electrode photovoltaic electrostatic hybrid actuator
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Lead-lanthanum zirconate-titanate (PLZT) ceramic has obtained widespread applications in the engineering fields. Especially, it has broad application prospects in the driving field. In this article, aiming at the proposed opto-electrostatic hybrid driving torsion actuator with a slant lower electrode, the influence of different factors on driving voltage and output deformation is analyzed and verified by a mathematical model and a variety of experiments. This study investigates the performance of a micro-actuator with slant lower electrode PLZT-based under different load configurations, with a focus on the influence of the copper foil as load. The actuator’s displacements are evaluated through experimental measurements and finite element analysis (FEA). The results consistently demonstrate that the full-size electrode configuration, utilizing copper foil exhibits higher driving voltage and displacements compared to the half-load configurations. The findings highlight the significant impact of the copper foil size on the actuator’s performance, emphasizing the importance of optimizing the load configuration for enhanced actuation capabilities. The results contribute to the understanding of load influences on the photovoltaic electrostatic actuator with slanted lower electrode and provide valuable insights for the design and optimization of the actuator.

articleTitle: A Method for Generating Sonar Pulse Database Based on Improved DCGAN Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Sonar pulse recognition refers to the process of extracting features from underwater sonar pulse signals and classifying targets. The main process includes feature extraction and target classification. However, the marine environment is complex, with reverberation, multipath effects, and interference noise from other ships or marine organisms, which greatly reduces the effectiveness of traditional sonar pulse detection and recognition. Deep learning takes the artificial intelligence neural network as the backbone, and it consists of multiple processing layers to study data with different orders of magnitude. A deep learning network model can process structured and unstructured data, while avoiding automatic feature extraction by manual operation. When the amount of data reaches a certain level, deep learning methods can effectively achieve precise recognition of sonar pulses. However, due to the difficulty of underwater data collection and high experimental costs, the size of the sonar pulse recognition training set is a key issue affecting recognition. Starting from introducing the structure of deep neural networks, this paper proposes a method for generating sonar pulse recognition training sets based on DCGAN (Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks).

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Controller for Aero-engine Distributed Control System with Short Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Different from the traditional centralized control system of aero-engine, distributed control system stands out for its advantages such as lower weight, higher system flexibility and better performance. But the sharing of communication network also brings about problems, among which time delay serves the most common one. To overcome the negative effect of time delay, a sliding mode controller is designed and RBF neural network is introduced to estimate disturbances. The discrete model of aero-engine distributed control system is first established. Then, a sliding mode controller based on power rate reaching law has been designed. Then to realize the lively estimation of disturbance, RBF neural network is applied for the system. Simulation results proves the effectiveness of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Performance Prediction of WQL Cooling Water Pump Based on CFD
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for numerical simulation and performance prediction. Firstly, hypermesh software is used to divide the internal fluid domain of the cooling water pump into an unstructured mesh. Then, the WQL cooling water pump is numerically simulated by using the computational fluid dynamics method. Finally, the distribution of performance parameters such as pump head, pressure, and turbulent kinetic energy are obtained. According to the calculation results, the pump’s performance is analysed and predicted, and the predicted head, efficiency, and power change trends align with the general laws of its performance characteristics. It shows that using CFD for fluid mechanical design can significantly reduce the cost of experiments and shorten the cycle of experiments. It has a specific reference value for engineers and technicians engaged in fluid machinery design.

articleTitle: Backstepping Control Design for Cooperative Flight of MAV/UAVs
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper investigates the cooperative flight control of manned/unmanned aerial vehicles (MAV/UAVs). The backstepping control strategy is proposed for the MAV/UAVs cooperative flight. Firstly, a tracking controller is designed for MAV to achieve the stable trajectory tracking. Then for UAVs, the distributed leader-following formation control scheme is established to keep the desired relative position with respect to the MAV. The proposed control laws guarantee the overall stability of the MAV/UAV system. Theoretical proofs and numerical simulations are provided, which verify the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on detection and protection of zero-line breakage in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Zero-line disconnection in low-voltage distribution network will lead to a significant voltage rise in the lightly loaded phase due to three-phase load imbalance, which may cause damage to a large number of power-using equipment and requires real-time monitoring and timely protection. The current technology cannot be prepared to judge the zero-line operation condition, with low action reliability and high chance of misoperation, which cannot meet the current power supply reliability requirements. In this paper, we propose a method based on active excitation to detect zero-line disconnection in distribution network, which is accurate and effective, and the accuracy and effectiveness of the method are verified by experimental tests.

articleTitle: Effect of intermediate pressure of two-stage compression on the performance of supercritical CO2 Brayton cycle
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The simple Brayton cycle consists of a combination of two constant pressure compression processes and two constant entropy processes. There are various ways to improve the cycle efficiency, of which changing the constant entropy compression process to a multi-stage compression is of great significance to improve the cycle efficiency. Using ENGINEERING EQUATION SOLVER software, a computer program was written for a supercritical CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> Brayton cycle model with recuperation, reheat and recompression processes. The effect of the intermediate pressure of the two-stage compression process (hereinafter referred to as the intermediate pressure) on the performance of the cycle in terms of compression power consumption, thermal efficiency, and exergy efficiency was investigated and analysed. The results show that the intermediate pressure of the two-stage compression process has a large influence on the cycle efficiency. There is an optimum pressure that minimises the compression power consumption, but at this point the cycle efficiency is not necessarily the highest, while there is an optimum pressure that maximises the cycle efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-objective design optimization of loading flange plate of megawatt wind turbine based on response surface method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Taking the loading flange plate (LFP) of 2MW wind turbine test platform as the research object. LFP fitted the 5-DOF load of the parallel hydraulic system and acted together with the axial torque supplied by the driving motor on the fan spindle to complete the loading test. The overall performance of LFP has great influence on the loading test. This paper adopts response surface method based on multi-objective driven optimization algorithm to optimize the design of LFP. SolidWorks was used for structural design of LFP. Workbench was used for statics analysis of LFP, and the optimization variables and their boundary conditions were determined. Taking the maximum equivalent stress (MES), maximum equivalent elastic strain (MEES), maximum total deformation (MTD), and mass of LFP as the optimization objectives, the sensitivity analysis of each optimization parameter was carried out. The response surface models of optimization variables and optimization objectives was established, and the optimal design point was selected from the three optimal design points through comparative analysis. The results showed that the MES, MEES, MTD, and mass of LFP were reduced by 4.78%, 2.61%, 1.18% and 0.71%, respectively, which met the requirements of loading test.

articleTitle: Rectification Cases of Vehicle Radiation Exceeding Standard Caused by Unconventional Low-voltage Components
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: When a pure electric vehicle was subjected to narrowband emission testing in accordance with the requirements of GB 34660-2017, there were multiple peaks that exceeded the standard. Use a spectrometer and near-field magnetic field probe for near-field scanning, and scan the installation area of the newly added components of the modified vehicle. When the probe approaches the position of the armrest box, the spectrum analyzer can capture multiple frequency interference signals, which are highly consistent with the vehicle test data. Ultimately, the disturbance source is determined to be the fragrance controller located at the lower part of the armrest box storage box. Finally, a rectification measure was proposed to directly add resistance to the output pins of the control board antenna chip, and to suppress interference by limiting the antenna transmission power. The rectification measures are easy to implement and have sufficient margin, providing support for mass production implementation.

articleTitle: Design and research of wind-solar hybrid power generation and hydrogen production system with energy storage
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Countries around the world are paying more and more attention to protecting the environment, and new energy technologies are being developed day by day. Hydrogen is considered a clean energy source and a future fuel to replace traditional fossil energy sources. In this paper, a hybrid system consisting of wind and solar power generation systems, an energy storage system, and an electrolytic water hydrogen production system is designed and investigated to form a wind and solar power production system and a hydrogen production system with energy storage. MPPT control and particle swarm algorithms are proposed to optimize the output power of the wind and PV systems, respectively. A system simulation model is built using Matlab/Simulink to verify its feasibility and improve power generation efficiency.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Straightening Phase of the Damping Umbrella of Submunitions
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This article introduces a method based on MATLAB/Simulink for calculating the maximum straightening force of submunition damping parachutes during the straightening process. Firstly, based on the motion law of the submunition after the submunition is opened, a flight dynamics model of the submunition parachute system is established. Then introduce how to use MATLAB/Simulink modular method to establish a simulation model, and conduct simulation calculations to obtain the maximum straightening force of the damping umbrella rope during the straightening stage. The simulation results well simulated the motion characteristics of the submunition parachute system during the damping parachute straightening stage, and proposed a calculation method for the maximum straightening force of the parachute rope during the straightening stage, which can provide assistance for the overall design of the submunition.

articleTitle: A operation error prediction method of gateway capacitive voltage transformer based on long short-term memory neural network and multi-task learning strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Accurate gateway capacitive voltage transformer (GCVT) operation error prediction can ensure the accuracy and fairness of power trading, which plays a vital role in ensuring the stability of the new power system and improving its operating efficiency. Aiming at the inefficiency of traditional GCVT periodic power failure detection methods, a operation error prediction method of gateway capacitive voltage transformer based on long short-term memory neural network and multi-task learning strategy is proposed, and it is applied to photovoltaic grid-connected gateways and the provincial power supply gateways. First, the multi-order Lagrangian difference method is used to fill in the missing values of the dataset, and all data are checked and corrected in standard format. Then, the ratio error and phase error in the GCVT operation process are predicted in parallel by using bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network, and the multi-task learning strategy is used to speed up the training speed of the model and improve the training effect. Finally, experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis Research on Firewall of Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Due to the frequent occurrence of fire accidents in converter stations, research on the insulation performance of converter station firewalls has become a hot topic. This article establishes a converter station firewall through finite element simulation software. Under the conditions of HC heating curve, the thermodynamic characteristics of the firewall were analyzed. The research results indicate that: Due to the irregular shape of the system, the temperature flow trend within the system is also irregular. Overall, heat flows from areas with higher temperatures to areas with lower temperatures. Due to the high thermal conductivity of square steel, the maximum heat flow is above the square steel, and the phenomenon of energy concentration gradually becomes apparent. In practical engineering, it is recommended to further provide fire protection for square steel.

articleTitle: A wind power prediction method considering wind turbine operating status based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the growing demand for clean energy, wind power generation has attracted increasing attention. However, traditional wind power prediction methods which rely on statistical models and physical equations have certain limitations, rendering them unable to handle nonlinear and non-stationary scenarios. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel wind turbine power prediction method based on the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks. The proposed method takes into account not only the historical power and wind speed data, but also the operational state parameters of the wind turbine are introduced as input, thereby enabling a more comprehensive consideration of the effect of the operational state on power generation. By applying the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks, the proposed method achieves high prediction accuracy and robustness, demonstrating its promising application prospects in wind turbine power prediction.

articleTitle: Drop Simulation Analysis and Structure Optimization of Heated Cigarette Device Based on Ansys Workbench
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To study the causes for the damage of heated cigarette device under drop impact, based on the finite element analysis, the initial design model of the device was established by using the Pro/E. Then, its FE model was set up with Ansys Workbench and the drop analysis was performed with the Pro/E. The force and deformation of the heated cigarette device under drop were analyzed by Ansys analysis. According to the results of simulation, the base frame structure optimization of the heated cigarette device was conducted. The results show that the displacement and deformation of the base frame of the heated cigarette device at the moment of lifting was 2mm, the average stress at the maximum stress was 9MPa, and the yield strength of the plastic material was 60MPa. After optimization, the displacement and deformation of the base frame of the heated cigarette device at the moment of lifting was 1mm, and the average stress at the maximum stress was 60MPa. The stress was 7.2MPa, and the yield strength of the plastic material was 120MPa.The stress was 7.2MPa, and the yield strength of the plastic material was 120MPa. According to the simulation results of this study, the structure of the device was optimized. After optimization, the stability of the device structure was improved and the anti-drop strength was increased.

articleTitle: Optimization of Data Flow in Smart Substation Considering Network Congestion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To meet the business requirements of centralized monitoring of smart substation, this paper optimizes the data flow in substation including the equipment. According to the basic principle of data flow design, the architecture of data interaction in smart substation is designed, and the corresponding communication bus scheme is given, which solves the problem of information transmission across regions. Furthermore, the data flow of substation implements comprehensive collection in different zones, and the cross-zone real-time bus synchronization technology is used in the station control layer to fully access the information of primary and secondary equipment and auxiliary equipment such as fire protection and security in real time, thus, the comprehensive monitoring of master-auxiliary integration is supported. Then by considering the sharp increase of data traffic in substation, the congestion control policy based on priority technology is proposed to solve the network congestion problem.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Detection Technology of high speed drill grinding
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Drilling occupies a large proportion in the field of machining. When drilling with drill bit, the quality and efficiency of drilling are greatly affected by the bit wear quality. In this paper, the detection methods and problems of high speed drill are analyzed, and the detection methods are innovated. In the unmanned explosion-proof public house, this paper proposes an automatic detection technology for detecting motor current drilling, which converts the change of motor current into voltage to calculate cutting force, and adopts the modular design principle, which is of great significance for the detection of drilling.

articleTitle: A cable condition assessment method based on cross-recursive feature elimination
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the face of the common problem of redundant features and imbalanced data distribution in cable sample data, a cable state evaluation method based on cross recursive feature elimination is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the importance of each feature is graded and ranked by using the cross-recursive feature elimination method based on random forest. Secondly, select the top four important features as key features and eliminate other redundant features. Finally, common traditional classification models were used to evaluate the cable ageing status of the original dataset and the dataset after feature elimination. Examples showed that the evaluation method proposed in this paper can effectively address the problem of redundant and imbalanced features in sample data, and the traditional classification algorithm has significantly improved the state evaluation speed and accuracy of cable data after feature elimination, a new direction can be provided for evaluating the ageing status of cables.

articleTitle: Design of automatic control system for cooling and dehumidification based on ESP8266
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A temperature and humidity monitoring and control system based on ESP8266 single-chip microcomputer is designed for showing the real-time temperature and humidity of the factory buildings and machine rooms and to control these two factors. This system takes the ESP8266-12F module as the control unit, and the DHT22 module as the temperature and humidity data acquisition module. The terminal equipment is connected to the Internet through WIFI, and the Alibaba Cloud Internet of things cloud platform can display the temperature and humidity data. The OLED screen is used for real-time data display on the worksite. After processing the data with the amplitude limiting filtering algorithm optimized by the weighted smoothing method, the algorithm is designed to control the 2-way optocoupler relay module to make the fan and the condensing fan operate. And the threshold is set for audible and visual alarm. This design is economical, practical, accurate in operation and basically does not require manual operation, and can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Development of bi-directional CLLLC resonant converter
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to promote the development of new energy and reduce the pollution caused by traditional fossil energy sources to the environment, bidirectional DC/DC converters, as the key link of energy conversion, are actively promoted in the fields of distributed energy, uninterruptible power supply systems and new energy storage systems. Among them, the bidirectional DC converter can achieve high efficiency power conversion and has a small switching tube voltage stress. In addition, the converter can realize high-power transmission, which can be widely used in the field of power electronics. In this paper, the bi-directional CLLLC resonant converter is studied in depth, and its circuit structure and operation principle are analyzed, and digital control technology is adopted to further improve the efficiency and accuracy of the converter, which will positively promote the development and application of bi-directional DC converter in the new energy field. In order to make the resonant converter operate stably, small-signal modeling of the converter is carried out, based on which the PI controller is designed and verified by forward and reverse closed-loop simulation, and a commutation control strategy based on the judgment of current and voltage magnitude is proposed.

articleTitle: Design of deployable structure of bionic space mesh antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The application fields of space mesh antennas cover mobile communication, electronic detection, signal relay, remote sensing, navigation, deep space exploration, etc. The rapid development of bionics provides a certain research basis for the diversification of mechanical structures. By exploring the folding process of flying biological wings, the bionic space mesh antenna deployable structure including drive structure, drive structure, spring hinge, repeatable self-locking/releasing structure, bionic rod and reflective surface is designed with the reference object of traditional rigid rib antenna, and by studying the effects of $\alpha$0, LAE and LPA on the folding ratio and the effects of the stroke percentage of ball screw sub on the frame mass, it is determined that: $\alpha_{0}$=$\pi$/90, LPA=5 mm, the length share of ball screw sub is 70$\sim$80%, the sum of ball screw sub length and deployable frame length is 1000±200 mm, and the specific parameters of deployable structure are initially solved to complete the 3D modeling and motion simulation. The antenna designed in this paper has a double-node support rigid rib structure with good scalability, and the arrangement of rotating nodes further improves the stability of the overall system, and this study further enriches the structural research of space antenna.

articleTitle: Design of embedded-based ceramic tile linear thermal expansion testing system
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to realise the automatic determination of linear thermal expansion of ceramic tiles, this paper designs the overall solution of the ceramic tile linear thermal expansion testing system. The upper computer software was designed using C# language and the STC8H8K64U microcontroller was used to implement the linear temperature rise control of the electric heater using a fuzzy adaptive PID control algorithm. The upper computer software is operated online with the controller to achieve the acquisition, storage, analysis and real-time curve plotting of temperature and displacement data to meet the testing requirements of ceramic tile production for linear thermal expansion index of ceramic tiles.

articleTitle: Research on the overall planning of digital workshop for equipment manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Digital workshops need to achieve digitization, networking, and intelligence in the production process. The construction of digital workshop is a systematic project, which requires a scientific planning and implementation process. Then promote the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing enterprises and improve quality and efficiency. This paper first introduces the planning method of digital workshop construction, then describes the overall architecture design, component modules and functions, and finally puts forward the implementation strategy of digital workshop planning for equipment manufacturing. The research content of this paper has been successfully applied in an electronic equipment manufacturing enterprise, which can provide reference and guidance for other equipment manufacturing enterprises to build digital workshops.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis and Topology Optimization of the Impeller Structure of Fog Gun Fan
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The main component of the multi-functional dust suppression vehicle fog gun fan is the moving impeller, which is subjected to complex loads in the process of accelerating the airflow. In order to ensure that the moving impeller can work normally, finite element analysis is carried out, including static analysis and modal analysis, and the structure topology optimization of the impeller of the fog gun fan is carried out to obtain a new impeller structure with stress and natural frequency as constraints. The calculation results show that the strength and natural frequency of the impeller after topology optimization meet the requirements, the mass is reduced by 23.2%, and the overall weight of the fog gun is reduced.

articleTitle: Algorithm Design for Smith Fuzzy PID Estimator for AGC of 1500mm Twelve-Roll Copper-Steel-Copper Composite Strip
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Design an optimized Smith fuzzy PID feedforward controller for the automatic thickness control of a 1500mm twelve-roll copper-steel-copper cold-rolled composite strip. Given the lag characteristics of the process, implement the proposed controller on a hydraulic pressure-based control model of the strip using MATLAB and SIMULINK software. Compare the performance of the conventional PID-Smith and the fuzzy PID+Smith controllers through simulation and analysis. The simulation results demonstrate that the fuzzy PID+Smith controller outperforms the PID-Smith controller in terms of robustness, dynamic response, and steady-state accuracy.

articleTitle: AlignMixup-based classification of mixed-type defect patterns in wafer bin maps
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Defect pattern classification of wafer bin maps (WBMs) is important owing to accurate classification is helpful in manufacture procedure improvement and so as to avoid further defects. Though the newest study of single defect WBM has made great progress, research seldom focus on the recognition of mixed-type defect WBMs possibly due to insufficient mixed-type defects data which is necessary during model training. Therefore, we suggest an AlignMixup-based classification approach to train convolutional neural networks with only a single defect WBMs data for mixed-type defects classification. Unlike previous approaches based on synthesizing mixed-type defect samples before model training, our method generates mixed-type defect WBMs adopting AlignMixup a powerful data augmentation method for model training. In the classification of WBM with two defect types, our method makes improvement by 16.9 % compared to previous settlements without consideration of mixed-type defect patterns. We performed on an real-world dataset of WBMs to prove the effectiveness and applicability of this approach. AlignMixup-based classification arrangement performs better than the state-of-the-art mixup approaches on five different benchmarks.

articleTitle: Structural description and design optimisation of integrated energy service systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to optimise the structural design of the integrated energy system and promote the energy internet into the landing stage. According to the multi-scale characteristics presented by the integrated energy service system in terms of levels and types, a model of each sub-system and its logical relationships are established from a systems engineering perspective, based on a multi-scale energy system modelling approach with the energy delivery network as the link. On the basis of system integration modelling, a mathematical model of system optimisation planning is established based on a simple algorithm structure and fast calculation speed particle swarm optimisation algorithm, with the annual comprehensive energy efficiency of the system as the optimisation target. On the premise of satisfying users’ energy demand for cooling, heating and electricity, and taking into account natural environmental resources, energy and environmental protection policies and other constraints, the planning and design of a scientific and reasonable integrated energy service system structure optimisation is realised, providing decision makers with an optimal energy supply solution.

articleTitle: Analysis of user electricity behavior based on improved K-Means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Data mining and clustering analysis based on a large amount of user electricity consumption data have become important means to improve the effectiveness of demand response scheduling. This article aims to conduct in-depth research on user electricity consumption behavior based on smart grid data using data mining and clustering analysis methods. Firstly, a large amount of user electricity consumption data is collected, and relevant features related to user electricity consumption behavior are extracted. Then, data mining techniques such as clustering analysis are applied to divide users into different groups. By comparing the electricity consumption characteristics and behavioral habits among different groups, the differences in electricity consumption between different user categories can be revealed. The results of this study are of great significance to power supply companies in implementing demand response scheduling, optimizing resource allocation, and improving the utilization of electric power energy. By fully mining user electricity consumption data under the smart grid, a decision-making basis can be provided for power supply companies and promote the sustainable development of the power industry.

articleTitle: Research on low frequency oscillation suppression of power system containing DFIG based on state feedback decoupling control
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A typical wind double-fed induction generator (DFIG) has limited ability to suppress low frequency oscillation (LFO) because of insufficient internal damping torque. This research proposes a state feedback decoupling control method, which is based on the closed-loop power system state space model. Considering DFIG as a feedback controller and decouple its transfer function array for state feedback. Realizing one-to-one control of angular velocity, work angle and impedance deviation vectors from synchronous generators. In addition, reducing the order of the mathematical model containing DFIG, adjusting the parameters $C_{g1},C_{g2},C_{g3}$ and suppressing the voltage amplitude variation at the point of common coupling (PCC). The purpose of improving the suppression of LFO is finally achieved. In the end, the wind power access four-machine two-area inter-degree model is simulated as an example and compared with the traditional state observer method. Simulation results demonstrate that this method could increase the overall system damping ratio and reduce the node voltage amplitude to suppress LFO.

articleTitle: A Two-stage optimization Model for Economic Operation in Integrated Electric-Gas Distribution Systems Considering E2H Conversion and Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Reliable and economical operation of active distribution power networks with multiple energy resources is essential in ensuring the complete absorption of renewable energy. This article presents a novel two-stage distributionally robust optimization (DRO) model to solve economic operation problems considering growing uncertainties. For solving the uncertainty optimization scheduling problems, a two-stage optimization model is formulated to dispatch each power station’s daily outputs in the first stage. Then, comprehensive norm constraints to limit the probability confidence intervals and the real-time operating adjustment cost under the worst-case distribution are considered to obtain the optimal adjustment plan for the previous scheduling plan in the second stage. The data-driven DRO algorithm is adopted to solve the two-stage optimization model that balances economic efficiency and conservatism of the scheduling results. The high efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method have been verified in case studies using actual data in an integrated energy system with electricity-to-hydrogen (E2H) devices.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Trajectory Control for Four-rotor UAV Based on Extremum Search
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Four-rotor UAV is an underactuated, strong coupling, and nonlinear system. The flight control results will have a large deviations, because of the uncertainty of the model and the influence of wind force. For this reason, the uncertainty and disturbance estimator (UDE) is adopted, and the extreme value search method (ES) is introduced to adjust the parameters of UDE. The trajectory controller of UAV with strong anti-disturbance ability is designed to reduce the deviation. Through experiments of trajectory tracking simulation. articleTitle: A review of research on extension strategy generation technology for the field of intelligent manufacturing engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Extension theory introduces new aspects in the modern technological environment with the use and development of artificial intelligence, ChatGPT, and data mining technologies. This paper summarizes the intelligent extension strategy generation method, clarifies the new decision-making method combining artificial intelligence and extension theory, and summarizes the principle, application, and trend analysis of extension strategy in the field of manufacturing engineering to further realize the mechanical integration of human-machine multi-information dynamic processing and physical systems. The Expandable Policy Generation (EPG) and the Extension Data Warehouse are specifically discussed in this paper, along with their relationship and generation processes. Additionally, a method to extract and store the extension knowledge used to resolve the contradiction problem in the extensive knowledge base is suggested. The core principles and processes from data-driven technology, data storage, and extended knowledge representation to optimal scheme generation are further elaborated upon in this study, which also highlights the actual implementation of EPG in the field of industrial engineering. This study concludes by summarizing the benefits and drawbacks of EPG and suggesting future research areas to advance the advancement of technology in the realm of intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Transmission line defect identification based on improved RetinaNet algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As an important part of power system, the safe and stable operation of transmission line is very important to ensure the power supply reliability of power grid. As most of the components of the transmission line are exposed in the field, affected by mechanical loads, complex environment and weather, various components will be rusted, damaged and peeled off in different degrees after long-term operation, which will have a significant negative impact on the safe and stable operation of the transmission line. Regular inspection and maintenance of the transmission line are required to eliminate defects and hidden dangers. In the past, manual patrol inspection was often carried out for line inspection, with high work intensity, long time consumption and low work efficiency. Therefore, intelligent patrol inspection is needed to replace manual patrol inspection. In recent years, the State Grid has gradually implemented the unmanned aerial vehicle patrol inspection method, which uses the target detection technology to check the line defects, but lacks high-precision target detection algorithm. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a target detection algorithm based on improved RetinaNet. And the experiment proves that the algorithm is superior and effective in transmission line defect detection.

articleTitle: Study on Cable Sealing Assemblies Layout Optimization for a UHVDC Project
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the deepening of converter station construction, the transmission capacity of UHV converter station is increasing, the voltage level is increasing, and more and more high-voltage equipment and power electronic equipment are used, which makes the electromagnetic environment in converter station more complicated. Cable shielding and blocking modules are often used in HVDC converter stations to restrain electromagnetic disturbance from entering secondary equipment through cables. In this paper, the electromagnetic interference suppression characteristics of the blocking module in UHV converter station are studied, mainly the shielding effectiveness and conduction suppression effect of the blocking module. Relying on the UHV DC projects in operation or newly-built commissioning in China, through the converter station field test, laboratory test and capital collection evaluation and analysis, the layout optimization suggestions of the blocking module are finally put forward.

articleTitle: Deep learning-based detection of part deformation for laser powder bed fusion process
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: During the manufacturing process of parts made by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), the dimensional accuracy of the part is one of the most important factors affecting the quality of the part and therefore in-situ real-time online monitoring of the part deformation is essential. To address these issues, a complete visualization method for LPBF part deformation detection has been developed in this study. Aiming at the problem that traditional digital image processing methods and machine vision used in the existing LPBF image segmentation are greatly affected by illumination and image quality, this paper uses a semantic segmentation model based on deep learning for the segmentation of powder bed background and parts. By comparing the segmentation performance of FCN, U-Net and DeepLabV3 models in different configurations, the U-Net(32) model with 32 basic convolutional kernels was chosen as the base framework, which were reduced by half compared to the U-Net model. The model has the advantages of effective segmentation, faster speed and smaller model, satisfying the basic requirements of real-time and easy to be deployed in industrial environments. In addition, this paper investigates the deformation intervals of parts without significant deformation and the variation pattern of deformation during the growth of warpage defects, which can provide reference information for feedback control in the future.
